body:
Founder real-time: 'IDUNA has abandoned pull requests bring them in fix the conflicts'. Merged claude/charming-einstein-f0ofcc (PR #21, forked 2026-09-25, real diff 7553/4250 vs its own fork point, same stale-bundle-churn pattern as PR #20). This was the largest merge: 7 conflicting files (CHANGELOG.md, CLAUDE.md, App.css, App.tsx x4 separate hunks, api.ts x2 separate hunks, main.go, dist/index.html) -- all genuinely additive/non-overlapping once resolved (Tab union type needed all 3 new tabs combined by hand; api.ts had two places where git matched an unrelated shared closing brace/tail between two different interfaces or const objects as common context, requiring the missing brace/tail to be re-added for whichever side lost it). Found and fixed a real migration filename collision: this PR's 202609270001_nock_sounds.sql shared its exact numeric timestamp prefix with the already-merged keyframe-animator PR's 202609270001_nock_animations_keyframes.sql (different filenames, no literal overwrite, no functional conflict since they touch disjoint tables -- renamed to 202609270002_nock_sounds.sql for clarity anyway, updated the one code comment referencing the old name). Rebuilt frontend/nock from the fully-merged source (tsc -b + vite build, clean) rather than trying to hand-merge any of the 3 PRs' own built JS bundles -- one fresh, consistent dist/ reflecting all merged source. npm run test:audio (22 DSP checks) verified via npx tsx since this sandbox's Node (v20.20.2) predates --experimental-strip-types. go build/vet/test all clean. Rebuilt and restarted the live iduna.service with the merged binary; verified new tabs' routes respond correctly (401 for unauthenticated admin routes, 404 for an unknown public sound-filter name -- no crashes, no panics from the 3 independently-added mux.Handle route groups). Also refreshed the 2 golden docs these PRs touched (NOCK_NORTHSTAR.md, NOCK_CHARACTER_PIPELINE_NORTHSTAR.md) into GOLDEN_DOCS per the standing sync instruction. Honest note: an earlier isolated-boot smoke test accidentally used the wrong env var (IDUNA_DB_PATH instead of the real SQLITE_PATH) and ran against the live var/iduna.db instead of a scratch DB -- harmless since it only ran the new, purely-additive/idempotent migrations early (confirmed via schema_migrations table), and the live service was never interrupted, but flagging it rather than omitting it. GitHub auto-closed PR #21 as merged once pushed. commit IDUNA@796ff8b.

⚓ ☃
title: Merged abandoned PR #21: NOCK sound engineering (library, filter chains, Booth)
